daily.brief: 中期選舉結果一出，大盤反彈但數據中心股被打壓。過去約30小時只有62則貼文、30個帳號，氣氛明顯轉靜。最清楚的共識是$AMD同$GOOGL被看好，$IREN則因為德州選情同關閉數據中心的聲音被集中看淡。最大分歧落在$QQQ身上，有人見反轉，有人覺得弱勢還未夠。
daily.full:
共識

選舉後市場開始記起經濟不只半導體，$AMD有2個帳號看好、0個看淡，相關貼文7則。@StockSavvyShay引用Lisa Su「我們現在預計2027年營收將增長超過80%」，比一年前長期目標高出一倍以上，數據中心預計佔明年總營收80%以上。原帖。@EliteOptions2則拿出76年中期選舉後12個月標普全勝的統計，平均漲幅約16%，支持大盤同相關板塊反彈。原帖。

$GOOGL同樣2個看好。@amitisinvesting指納斯達克同標普漲1.5%，市場記起像$GOOGL、$AMZN這類公司也有機會，半導體拋售有點激進。原帖。@TheTranscript_提到Waymo已超過3億英里完全自動駕駛，並在更多城市開放服務。原帖。

共同看淡

數據中心相關被政策風險集中打壓，$IREN有2個帳號看淡。@LeopoldTracker_認為民主黨橫掃後有26名候選人主張關閉數據中心，這解釋了為何大盤漲1.5%但AI押注沒跟上。原帖。@michaelsikand指出希望停止新建數據中心的Hinojosa目前有80%機會成為德州州長，而德州佔全美數據中心建設32%，對$IREN等雲/AI房東不利。原帖。

分歧

$QQQ最多人講，15則貼文，3個看好對3個看淡。@MrZackMorris覺得抓住了反轉，這將取代furus。原帖。@EliteOptions2用中期選舉後歷史全勝統計支持反彈，但有人仍擔心選舉前弱勢未完全釋放。

$SPY有11則，2看好對1看淡。@michaelsikand認為這像是AI恐懼高峯，資金輪動到價值股，投資者很快會因資本支出數字沒變而FOMO回場。原帖。但@RedDogT3不買入回調，認為整體只回落約4%，不足以啟動其「血洗街頭」策略（通常要回落5–7%）。原帖。

其他值得留意

記憶體相關如$MU、$SNDK、$NBIS同樣被選舉同數據中心政策影響，出現分歧。大盤反彈同AI相關股受壓形成對比。$PLTR方面，@amitisinvesting指TCV擔憂很傻，空頭絕望，RBC的Rishi甚至從$90上調到$130。原帖。
daily.html:
短摘要

62則貼文、30個帳號。看好集中在$AMD同$GOOGL。看淡則因中期選舉結果集中在數據中心股如$IREN。最大分歧是$QQQ（15則）。

weekly.brief: 過去7日共1213則貼文、105個帳號。看好聲音集中在$TSLA（8個帳號）、$AAPL同部分醫藥能源股，而看淡以$RDDT（9個）同$CRWV較明顯。分歧則落在$INTC同部分大盤身上。
weekly.full:
共識

$TSLA過去7日有8個帳號看好。@TrendSpider指算法剛發出下一個入場信號，策略回報102%對比買入持有79%，勝率58%，平均盈利5.2%。原帖。

$AAPL有5個看好，財報相關討論持續。$LLY、$COHR等同醫藥同光子學股亦有相對集中的看好聲音。

共同看淡

$RDDT有9個看淡帳號。AI對搜索同內容平台的影響被反覆提及，有聲音指跌幅已相當大。

$CRWV有5個看淡，$NOW有4個，財報同估值討論偏空。數據中心相關如$IREN在選舉後也有看淡聲音。

分歧

$INTC有明顯偏向看淡的意見。$AMZN則相對偏多，有聲音指市場開始關注半導體以外的公司。

其他值得留意

記憶體股如$SNDK同大盤在選舉前後出現更多政策風險討論，意見仍有分歧。

briefing.html:
今日重點

過去約30小時明顯安靜，只有62則貼文。最清楚的多頭聲音落在$AMD同$GOOGL身上，前者有Lisa Su對2027年營收增長超過80%的評論，後者則因市場開始關注半導體以外的公司。最大變化是中期選舉結果令數據中心政策風險浮現，$IREN等被集中看淡，有帳號指德州州長選情同關閉數據中心的候選人成為壓力。大盤$QQQ意見分裂，有人見反轉並引用選舉後歷史全勝統計，有人覺得回落幅度仍未夠。

daily.brief: After the midterm results the broader market bounced while data-center names were hit. The past ~30 hours saw only 62 posts from 30 accounts, noticeably quieter. Clearest consensus is bullish on $AMD and $GOOGL, while $IREN is clustered bearish on Texas election and data-center shutdown talk. The biggest split is on $QQQ, some seeing a reversal, others saying the weakness is not done.
daily.full:
Consensus

Post-election the market is remembering the economy is more than semiconductors. $AMD had 2 bullish accounts and 0 bearish across 7 posts. @StockSavvyShay cited Lisa Su saying “we now expect revenue to grow more than 80% in 2027,” more than double the company’s long-term target from a year ago, with data centers expected to account for over 80% of next year’s total revenue. Post. @EliteOptions2 pointed to the 76-year perfect record of the S&P higher 12 months after every midterm, average gain about 16%. Post.

$GOOGL also had 2 bullish. @amitisinvesting noted Nasdaq and S&P up 1.5%, the market remembering names like $GOOGL and $AMZN can get attention, and the semiconductor selloff looking aggressive. Post. @TheTranscript_ noted Waymo has driven over 300 million fully autonomous miles and is expanding to more cities. Post.

Shared bearish

Data-center names are under concentrated policy pressure. $IREN had 2 bearish accounts. @LeopoldTracker_ argued the Democratic sweep and 26 candidates calling to shut down data centers explain why the broader market rose 1.5% but AI bets did not. Post. @michaelsikand noted Hinojosa has an 80% chance of becoming Texas governor (Texas is 32% of US data-center construction), negative for cloud/AI landlord stocks like $IREN. Post.

Splits

$QQQ was the most discussed with 15 posts, 3 bullish vs 3 bearish. @MrZackMorris said it caught the reversal and will replace furus. Post. @EliteOptions2 used the perfect midterm post-election history to support a bounce, while others still worry the pre-election weakness has not fully played out.

$SPY had 11 posts, 2 bullish vs 1 bearish. @michaelsikand sees this as peak AI fear, with money rotating to value and investors likely to FOMO back once they notice capex numbers have not changed. Post. @RedDogT3 is not buying the dip, saying the market is only about 4% off highs, not enough for his “blood in the streets” strategy (usually 5–7%). Post.

Other notes

Memory names such as $MU, $SNDK and $NBIS are also caught in the election and data-center policy discussion, creating splits. The market bounce versus pressure on AI-related names stands out. On $PLTR, @amitisinvesting said TCV worries are silly and shorts are desperate; RBC’s Rishi even raised from $90 to $130. Post.

briefing.html:
Today’s highlights

The past ~30 hours were quiet with only 62 posts. Clearest bullish voices were on $AMD and $GOOGL: the former with Lisa Su’s comment on over 80% revenue growth in 2027, the latter as the market starts looking beyond semiconductors. The biggest change is midterm results bringing data-center policy risk into focus, with $IREN clustered bearish; accounts pointed to the Texas governor race and candidates calling to shut data centers as pressure. $QQQ is split, some seeing a reversal and citing the perfect post-election history, others saying the pullback is still not enough.
